candidates.reason: Directly covers the scrapy.utils.ssl helpers that should own shared SSLKEYLOGFILE destination and key-material handling, including the stdlib SSLContext creation path.
Exercises the Twisted/pyOpenSSL context factory used by the HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 handlers, where key logging must be installed without changing TLS behavior.
Provides end-to-end HTTPS coverage for the stdlib SSLContext path owned by the HTTPX download handler.
Provides end-to-end HTTPS coverage for the Twisted HTTP/1.1 handler, which consumes the shared context factory.
Verifies the HTTP/2 handler also inherits SSLKEYLOGFILE behavior through the shared Twisted context factory.
